newsitem.title: UK: NWE gasoline slips 50 cts in thin late trade.
newsitem.headline: NWE gasoline slips 50 cts in thin late trade.

text.p: NWE gasoline prices slipped quitely lower on Firday, trading 50 cents lower at $201.50 fob Rotterdam for Eurgrade barges.
Dealers said the market remained in contango until June and then backwardated $5 a tonne into July.
They said oil companies remain confident of a tax hike in the U.K. to take place in June or July.
"The majors have been buying but i'ts just a punt on Brown," said a trader referring to the U.K. Chancellor.
